metadata.description: Thirty-item cancer-specific health-related quality-of-life questionnaire with functional and symptom scales.
metadata.intended_use: Oncology clinical trials, cancer care, survivorship, and health-outcomes research.
metadata.name_origin: EORTC QLQ-C30 is the 30-item core questionnaire of the European Organisation for Research and Treatment of Cancer quality-of-life system.
metadata.development_history: Developed as a cross-cultural core measure with disease- and treatment-specific modules.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Functioning, symptoms, global health, and quality of life are measured together to capture patient-reported cancer outcomes.
metadata.interpretation_notes: Use the official German translation, scoring manual, and applicable EORTC permissions; modules and core scores must not be mixed casually.

versions.source_citation: Aaronson et al. (1993). The European Organisation for Research and Treatment of Cancer QLQ-C30.

source_documents.title: EORTC QLQ-C30 official questionnaire reference
source_documents.license_name: EORTC questionnaire; official translation and use terms apply
source_documents.permission_basis: Only discovery and bibliographic metadata is stored. Item wording and forms are excluded until the exact German version and reuse terms are verified.

cosmin_metrics.internal_consistency: Cronbach's alpha für die meisten Funktions-/Symptomskalen ca. >.70 in der internationalen Validierungsstudie; einzelne Skalen (z.B. Kognition) liegen teils niedriger.
cosmin_metrics.source: Aaronson NK, Ahmedzai S, Bergman B, et al. (1993). The European Organization for Research and Treatment of Cancer QLQ-C30. J Natl Cancer Inst, 85(5), 365-376.

versions.recall_period: letzte Woche bzw. aktueller Gesundheitszustand je Item
versions.item_structure: 30 Items; Dimensionen: global health, physical functioning, role functioning, emotional functioning, cognitive functioning, social functioning, symptoms.
versions.scoring_notes: Funktions- und Symptomskalen werden nach EORTC-Scoring Manual linear transformiert; höhere Werte haben je Skala unterschiedliche Bedeutung.
versions.psychometric_summary: QLQ-C30 ist international in Onkologie und klinischen Studien umfangreich validiert; Sprachversion und Module sind getrennt zu prüfen.
